hook_text: Some things changed over five hundred years of trade. Some things never did. Can you sort them?
clip_script: Giyani, two washing lines. On the continuity line: gold and ivory going out, glass beads and cloth coming in, dhows sailing with the monsoon, porters walking to the coast, leaders controlling trade. On the change line: the trading centre moved from Schroda to K2, to Mapungubwe, to Great Zimbabwe. Kilwa grew rich from the gold trade. Then, around 1500, Portuguese ships arrived and built a fort at Sofala. Change and continuity: two ways of looking at history.
visual_style: Whiteboard classroom with two washing lines, cards pegged one by one, a timeline running from 900 to 1500 underneath.
mood: Thoughtful and organised, like a detective sorting clues.
pacing: Steady pegging of cards, alternating lines, ending with the arrival of the Portuguese.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make your own change and continuity table.
